name: PHILLIPS, Fiona Evon

headline.note: The parliamentary biography supplies year-level boundaries for seven overlapping pre-parliament roles. A reliable election profile describes the 2007–2009 Defence role as full-time, but exact appointment and cessation dates remain unavailable. Hours are not established for Westpac, council, the workplace-learning nonprofit, TAFE, the University of Wollongong or political staff work. Year labels are retained without inventing calendar boundaries, and no public or private full-time total is published.

career_spells.role: Bachelor of Economics student, majoring in Industrial Relations and Labour Economics
career_spells.evidence_note: The Parliament profile records the BEc; ABC's election guide identifies the major and says the degree was completed in 1991. Start date, study load and any work overlap are not stated.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official/member sources establish the Master of Business; 2015 and 2016 ABC candidate biographies date completion with distinction to 2011. Enrolment, study load, leave and employment overlap remain unresolved. Public profile dates study2008–2011. Study load and arrangements during Defence employment still unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: 2016 candidate biography identifies this additional study. Course, award, dates, load and overlap with banking remain unknown.

career_spells.role: Retail banking, followed by Senior Industrial Relations Officer for Retail Banking
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament gives 1991–1995 and names Westpac and the role; ABC corroborates a post-degree senior industrial-relations career at a major bank. Exact dates, employment basis, hours, leave and the 1995–1996 transition are unresolved. Public profile partitions the aggregate: retail banking1991–1993, senior industrial-relations officer1993–1995. Preserve official1991–1995 employment interval while no longer implying the senior title applied throughout. Retail banking locations include Royal North Shore Hospital, Milsons Point and Martin Place; the hospital is a bank location, not a separate health employer. Exact transitions and hours remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: The employer is private, but year-only boundaries and missing substantive full-time evidence prevent a headline duration.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography identifies council employment from 1996 to 1997. Exact dates, employment basis, hours, leave and overlap with the workplace-learning transition are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Council control is public, but the record does not support a full-time duration calculation.

career_spells.employer: Shoalhaven Schools Workplace Learning Program / Illawarra Schools Workplace Learning Program Incorporated
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament gives the Shoalhaven program and 1997–2002; Phillips' biography confirms the role. The continuing incorporated entity says it began in 1997 and is a locally based not-for-profit, while ABN history records the incorporated entity from 2000. Exact employing entity before 2000, dates, hours, leave and funding/control arrangements are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: The role is coded nonprofit and excluded from the narrow public/private headline; public funding alone would not establish public control.

career_spells.employer: TAFE NSW — Illawarra Institute, Nowra campus (historical structure)
career_spells.evidence_note: Official and first-person sources establish teaching at Nowra TAFE from 2002 to 2017, including Outreach work helping learners return to work and training. Exact dates, appointment type, hours, leave and overlap with university, Defence, campaigning and political staff work are unresolved. Contemporary candidate profile and NSW parliamentary campus record resolve the historical institute name. No employment-basis inference follows from campus structure. Public profile refines the interval toNovember2002–August2017 and names prevocational programs, outreach and communications. Month precision supersedes earlier year-only boundaries; ordinary hours and overlap arrangements remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: The public employer is supported, but neither full-time status nor countable boundaries are established.

career_spells.role: Commerce Tutor teaching management, finance and leadership
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament supplies 2002–2015; Phillips' biography identifies subjects taught at the Shoalhaven Campus. Exact dates, casual/continuing basis, hours, leave and overlap with TAFE and Defence are unresolved. The 2016 ABC guide still uses present-tense tutoring, which may repeat older text. Preserve official 2015 end year pending employer confirmation rather than extend employment automatically.
career_spells.counting_note: University employment is shown separately and excluded from the narrow headline under the current codebook.

career_spells.employer: Australian Department of Defence — Defence Materiel Organisation, Navy Aviation Systems Program Office, HMAS Albatross
career_spells.role: Civilian Business Operations Manager / Strategic Workforce Planner
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament gives 2007–2009. Phillips calls the role civilian and adds strategic-workforce-planner duties; ABC describes it as full-time. Exact start/end dates, leave and how simultaneous TAFE and university work was arranged are unresolved. Public profile identifies Defence Materiel Organisation as the organisational unit; no separate private employer inferred.
career_spells.counting_note: Public control and full-time status are supported, but year-only boundaries do not justify an exact headline total.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography establishes the role and 2016–2017 range. Exact dates, payroll, hours, leave and overlap with teaching and campaigning are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: South Coast SEC President; Country Labor Committee and NSW Administrative Committee member
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament records South Coast SEC president in 2014–2017, Country Labor Committee membership in 2016–2019 and NSW Administrative Committee membership in 2017–2019. Remuneration, hours and overlap are not stated.
career_spells.counting_note: Party organisational activity is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Candidate for South Coast (2015) and Gilmore (2016 and 2019)
career_spells.evidence_note: ABC's 2019 election profile and Phillips' first speech describe the multi-election campaign path culminating in election on 18 May 2019. Preselection dates, remuneration, campaign workload and any paid employment after 2017 are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party candidacy and campaigning are excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Member of the House of Representatives for Gilmore
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster and current parliamentary profile establish continuous House service from the 18 May 2019 election.
career_spells.counting_note: Federal elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Save the Nowra Pool community campaign
career_spells.evidence_note: Member biography gives the campaign interval. Legal organisation, pay, hours and any leave from employment are unknown; community activity is not assumed to be paid work.
career_spells.counting_note: Community campaigning excluded from substantive employment totals.

research_notes: Obtain month/day appointment and cessation records, hours and leave for Westpac, Shoalhaven City Council and Defence; resolve the unreported 1995–1996 period.

Obtain TAFE, University of Wollongong and workplace-learning appointment types, workloads, leave and exact dates, particularly through the 2007–2009 Defence overlap and 2015–2017 campaign/political-staff overlap.
Identify the exact employing entity and government-control/funding arrangements for Shoalhaven Schools Workplace Learning Program in 1997–2000.
Resolve paid employment, campaign remuneration and breaks from the end of the listed 2017 roles to the 18 May 2019 election.

No exact headline years are inferred from year-only ranges. The ABC full-time description for Defence is retained, but its duration remains uncalculated pending precise boundaries. Missing evidence is not zero.

2026-10-01 follow-up adds Securities Institute study, 2011 masters completion, historical Illawarra TAFE identity and the 2009–2015 pool campaign. Records conflict between official 2015 university cessation and present-tense tutoring in the 2016 guide; no invented extension.

Searched public parliamentary/member biographies, contemporary election guides, institutional UOW/UNSW pages, workplace-learning organisation/registry history, historical campus records, banking name variants and teaching hours terms. No exact work appointments, ordinary teaching hours, Defence leave or 1995–1996/2017–2019 paid-work chronology found. Current organisation office opening hours do not establish personal historic hours.

Next evidence priorities: UOW appointment/cessation confirmation addressing the 2016 guide; TAFE personnel arrangements during Defence work; Securities Institute award and banking overlap; school-workplace programme’s original employer. A secondary generic reference to retail experience was not expanded into a separate employer; it may refer to retail banking. Spouse’s carpentry business is not evidence she worked there.

Second follow-up2October2026 refines Westpac title progression, TAFE month boundaries, Defence organisational unit and masters commencement from the public professional profile. Do not count a hospital-named bank branch as health employment or apply1993–1995 senior duties to1991–1993 automatically. Official aggregate dates remain preserved. Queries for employment hours and university cessation did not resolve the existing overlap or2015/2016 discrepancy. Deakin music lecturer, IP lawyer, equestrian director and UK broadcaster are namesakes excluded. Next priorities remain TAFE leave/workload during Defence, exact Defence appointment dates, UOW cessation and1995–1996/2017–2019 gaps; no full-time totals changed.
